(nya)༄༅/ /mkha' 'gro ma seng ge'i gdong pa can gyi gtor ma la brten nas phyir zlog pa'i man ngag snying po dgra bgegs dpung 'joms zhes bya ba bzhugs so/

tei:div.tei:p: (nya)༄༅// mkha' 'gro ma seng ge'i gdong pa can gyi gtor ma la brten nas phyir zlog pa'i man ngag snying po dgra bgegs dpung 'joms zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༄༅// ji snyed ye shes ḍā ki ma'i// gtso mo seng ge'i gdong can dang*// dbyer med bla ma la btud nas// de yi gtor zlog bsdus te spel// 'dir mkha' 'gro ma seng ge'i gdong can gyi sgo nas gtor zlog bya bar 'dod pa'i gang zag gis gnas khang yid dang mthun par byi dor byas la/ rten byin can rnams bshams pa'i mdun du yi dam chos skyong gi skong gtor thun gtor rnams rgyun bzhin dang*/ lhag par yi dam gyi gtor ma zur gsum dmar po mtheb kyus bskor ba zhi drag gi nyer spyod bcas tshul bzhin bsham/ de dag gi mdun sogs gang 'os zhig tu rdul tshon sogs kyis chos 'byung gru gsum mthing nag gi phyi rol du me ri 'bar ba dang bcas pa bris/ de'i mdun du padma 'dab bzhi'i lte bar nyi gdan re'i lte ba/ shar dkar lho ser nub dmar byang ljang dbus sngon po'i tshon spungs dgod/ de'i steng du mañdzi'i khar lcags snod kyi nang du 'bru nag khrag chang gis sbrus pa'i dmar gtor zur gsum 'khor bzhi bcas me ri sku tsaka gis spras pa'i mthar skyer rtsangs dang thod skam rgyu ma'i lda ldis brgyan cing dar nag gi gdugs phug pa sha khrag chang gis btab pa brjid ldan bsham/ mdun du gtor zor rtsangs gzengs pa/ lcags zangs rdo phye ke shang yungs dkar nag sogs thun rdzas/ mtshe dang yungs kar gyi gong bu/ rdo zor gru gsum/ mda' gzhu/ khrag sna dug sna bcas kyi mthar drag po'i nyer spyod/ gtor ma'i mdun hom khung du liṅga kheb bcas dang*/ rnal 'byor pa rnams la mkho ba'i yo byad rnams kyang tshang bar bsham mo// ngag 'don la thog mar sngon 'gro gtor ma chus bran la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum gyis brlab/ oṃ sarba bighnān sogs gsum gyis bsngos la/

hūm̐/ bka' gsang rmad byung dkyil 'khor 'dir// gsang ba'i dam can so so nas// 'du ba'i lha ni ma gtogs pa'i// bgegs dang log 'dren 'byung po'i tshogs// mchod sbyin gtor mas tshim gyis la// 'di ru ma 'dug gzhan du song*// ci ste mi 'gro 'dug gyur na// seng gdong drag mor khros nas ni// khyed cag lus ngag yid gsum rnams// rdul phran bzhin du brlag par 'gyur// de bas rang rang gnas su deng*// oṃ sarba bighnān gatstsha/ a ka sa ma sogs rol mo dang thun bcas bgegs bskrad/ mtshams bcad pa ni/ hūm̐/ nga ni seng gdong drag mo ste// sku gsung thugs kyi cho 'phrul las// ye shes khro mos nam mkha' gang*// dam tshig mkha' 'gros bar snang gang*// las byed mkha' 'gros sa gzhi gang*// phyogs mtshams rdo rje'i rwa gur brtsegs// me rlung 'tshubs mas snang srid 'gengs// bgegs rigs 'dug pa'i skabs med do// rtsa sngags kyi mthar/ oṃ badzra rakṣa rakṣa hūm̐ phaṭa ces rol mo dang gu gul gyis bdugs/ mchod pa byin rlabs ni/ oṃ gyis chos rnams stong par gyur pa'i ngang*// āḥlas dung chen thod pa yangs pa'i nang*// hūm̐ las phyi nang dgra bgegs bsgral byung gi// khrag zhag yon chab dbang lnga'i me tog dang*// tshil chen spos dang zhun chen mar me gsal// mkhris pa'i dri chab sha rus zhal zas ri// rkang gling rnga dung rol mo bsam mi khyab// bdud rtsi sman mchog rakta'i rgya mtsho che// sha rus brtsegs pa'i gtor ma 'dod yon lnga// dpag yas mchod sprin zhing kun khyab par gyur// oṃ badzra arghaṃ nas/ shabda āḥhūm̐ gi bar gyis nyer spyod dang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta hūm̐ hrīḥtha/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ma hā rakta dzwa la maṇḍal hūm̐ hrīḥtha/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ma hā ba liṃ ta ba la ba ti gu hya siddhi sa ma ya hrūm̐ hrīḥtha/ zhes sman rag gtor gsum dang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ sarba pū dza me gha sa mu dra spha ra ṇa swā hā/

zhes mchod pa thams cad mi zad par byin gyis brlab bo// bdag bskyed dngos la/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed tshad med bzhi rnams spyi ltar dang*/ swa bhā bas sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las padma dang ram̐ las nyi ma la gnas pa'i hūm̐ yig las byung ba'i sna tshogs rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ de yongs su gyur pa las 'og rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ logs rdo rje'i rwa ba/ steng rdo rje'i gur/ phyi rol thams cad ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i srung ba'i 'khor lo yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du dur khrod chen po 'jigs shing skyi g.ya' bas bskor ba'i dbus su/ e las chos 'byung gru gsum mthing nag gdengs ka che ba gyen du phyogs pa/ de'i dbus kyi nam mkhar pam̐ las sna tshogs padma dang ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ yig mthing nag gsal zhing 'tsher ba/ de las 'od zer 'phros gdug pa can thams cad tshar bcad/ dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rnams kyi nus mthu thams cad bsdus nas hūm̐ la thim/ de yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma seng ge'i gdong pa can sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ seng zhal rab tu gdangs shing*/ mche ba gtsigs nas ljags glog ltar 'khyugs pa/ spyan gsum dmar la zlum zhing bgrad pa/ dbu skra dang smin ma dang sma ra dang ag tshom dmar ser gyen thur du 'khyil pa las me'i tshwa tshwa 'phro ba/ phyag g.yas pas rdo rjes mtshan pa'i gri gug nam mkha' la phyar zhing*/ g.yon thod pa khrag gis gang ba thugs kar 'dzin pa/ gru mo g.yon na kha ṭwāṃ ga bsnams pa/ nu 'bur mtho zhing rgyas pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ rin po che dang rus pa'i rgyan lngas brgyan pa/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ zhabs g.yas bskum zhing g.yon brkyangs pa'i stabs kyis mi ro dmar ser mgo bo g.yon du bstan pa'i snying gar brdzis shing ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/

de'i 'khor du ye shes dang 'jig rten pa'i dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dpag tu med pas bskor bar gyur/ lha de thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas 'og min mkha' spyod o rgyan la sogs pa'i gnas nas mkha' 'gro ma seng ge'i gdong pa can la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ zhes spyan drangs/ oṃ ḍā ki nī siṃ ha mu khī sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badzra puṣpe sogs nas/ shabda āḥhūm̐ gi bar gyis mchod la/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥzhes pas rang la gnyis su med par bstim/ slar yang thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥs spyan drangs/ oṃ pañtsa ku la sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la sogs gsol ba btab pas/ oṃ badzrī bha ba a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐ zhes gsung zhing dbang bskur sku gang dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las spyi bor mi bskyod pa'i ngo bo rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pas dbur brgyan par bsam/ oṃ ḍā ki nī siṃ ha mu khī sa pa ri wā ra sbyar ba'i arghaṃ nas shabda'i bar gyis mchod/ seng ge rnam par bsgyings pa'i zhal can ma// mthon mthing 'od stong 'phro ba'i mig yangs ma// dpa' mo dgyes pa'i gad rgyangs cher sgrogs ma// ye shes mkha' 'gro ma la phyag 'tshal bstod// ces bstod cing*/ lha sku snang la rang bzhin med pa la mnyam par bzhag de las ldang ba na/ rang gi snying gar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ yig mthing nag sngags kyi phreng bas g.yon du bskor ba las 'od zer me phung lta bu dpag tu med pa 'phros pas lus kyi phyi nang thams cad khyab/ nad gdon sdig sgrib byad ka rbod gtong*/ mi dang mi ma yin pa'i gnod pa thams cad reg pa tsam gyis tshar bcad/

bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i byin rlabs dang nus mthu thams cad 'od zer gyi rnam par bsdus nas rang la thim pas rgyud byin gyis brlabs par bsams la/ a ka sa ma ra tsa sha da ra sa ma ra ya phaṭa/ ces bsnyen sngags ci nus bzlas la/ mchod bstod bya/ bcom ldan 'das ma bdag dang sems can gyi nad gdon sdig sgrib bgegs dang bar du gcod pa thams cad nye bar zhi ba dang*/ gzhan gyi byad ka rbod gtong thams cad phyir bzlog pa dang*/ myur du mkha' 'gro ma seng ge'i gdong can ma'i go 'phang thob par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes 'dod don gsol/ zlog pa ni/ a ka sa ma sogs la lha srin sde brgyad mi dang mi ma yin pa'i byad ka rbod gtong thams cad byad ma gnod byed kyi steng du e sa bhyoḥbhyoḥzlog zlog ces btags pa dang sngags mgo mjug ldog pa ji ltar rigs pa bzla/ mthar/ rang gi lag mthil g.yas g.yon nyi zla'i dkyil 'khor gyi bar du dgra bgegs dmigs la/ rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi= chos kyi= dge 'dun gyi= gsang sngags dang rig sngags kyi rgyal po khro bo khro mo rnams kyi= mkha' 'gro ma seng ge'i gdong pa can mkha' 'gro bye ba 'bum sde'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ bden pa chen po'i byin gyis brlabs kyis bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la nad gdon bar chad chag che nyam nga byad ka rbod gtong la sogs pa mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad da lta nyid du phyir bzlog par gyur cig med par gyur cig stong par gyur cig ces brjod la thal mo lan gsum brdab/ rtsa sngags la trir tsa sa ma ya byad ma'i srog la gtubs/ zhes btags pa cung zad bzlas la/ khro bo 'bar ba'i sogs brjod/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas gdan 'od zer gyi rnam par gyur nas rang la thim par bsam mo// gtor 'bul ni/

gtor ma rnams dang nang mchod gnyis ka a mṛ tas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sogs nas/ byin gyis brlab pa'i bar dang*/ gtor ma'i steng gi nam mkhar sogs gtor chog mdzes rgyan bzhin dang*/ yang byin rlabs dran par byas te/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥlan gsum gyis byin brlab/ gtor mgron/ mdun gyi nam mkhar pam̐ las sna tshogs padma sogs nas/ rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pas dbur brgyan pa'i bar yan lag bzhi rdzogs su bskyed pa'am/ mi nus na/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas mkha' spyod la sogs pa'i gnas nas ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma seng ge'i gdong pa can la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ zhes spyan drangs pas kyang rung*/ gang ltar yang mdun bskyed kyi lha'i ljags rdo rje'i sbu gu'i 'od kyis gtor ma drangs te gsol bar bsam zhing*/ rdo rje thal mo kha gyen du phye ste/ oṃ ḍā ki nī siṃ ha mu khī sa pa ri wā ra oṃ a kā ro sogs btags pa gsum mam lnga sogs kyis phul/ gong ltar mchod pas mchod/ oṃ ḍā ki nī siṃ ha mu khī sa pa ri wā ra oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes pas nang mchod 'bul/ sngar gyi bstod pa bsdus pas bstod/ mkha' 'gro'i gtso mo seng ge'i gdong can ma// dam rdzas bdud rtsi'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la// skyabs su song ba'i rnal 'byor bdag cag rnams// nam yang g.yel med rtag tu skyong bar mdzod// khyed thugs dgyes pa'i chu skyes las byung ba'i// dngos grub bde chen bdud rtsi'i bcud chen pos// ltos bcas bung ba bdag cag tshim mdzad de// mkha' 'gro spyod pa'i gnas su 'khrid du gsol// zhes pas phrin las bcol te 'dod don gsol lo// slar yang 'bru gsum gyis byin rlabs dran te/ gur zhal/ las mgon/ mkha' 'gro spyi gtor bcas dang*/

spro na skong gso kollī mgo bar nar 'ded du btang bar bya'o// de nas mdun bskyed sgrub pa la/ mdun gyi maṇḍal gtor ma bcas a mṛ tas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las padma dang ram̐ las nyi ma sogs nas/ chos 'byung gru gsum mthing nag gdengs ka che ba gyen du phyogs pa/ de'i dbus kyi nam mkhar pam̐ las sna tshogs padma 'dab ma bzhi pa'i lte ba dang 'dab ma rnams la ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor re re'i steng hūm̐ yig re re/ de'ang dbus kyi mthing nag shar gyi dkar po/ lho'i ser po/ nub kyi dmar po/ byang gi ljang gu rnams gsal zhing 'tsher ba/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ gdug pa can thams cad tshar bcad/ dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rnams kyi nus mthu thams cad bsdus nas hūm̐ rnams la thim/ de rnams yongs su gyur pa las dbus su ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma seng ge'i gdong pa can mthing nag shar du sangs rgyas rigs kyi seng gdong can dkar mo/ lhor rin chen rigs kyi seng gdong can ser mo/ nub tu padma'i rigs kyi seng gdong can dmar mo/ byang du las kyi rigs kyi seng gdong ma ljang gu thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma sogs nas/ phyag g.yas pa rnams kyis rang rtags kyis mtshan pa'i gri gug nam mkha' la 'phyar ba/ g.yon pa rnams kyis thod pa sogs nas me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ gzhan yang de dag gi 'khor du ye shes pa dang 'jig rten pa'i rigs kyi dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gro bka' srung dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs dpag tu med par bskor ba dang bcas par gyur/ de rnams kyi dpral bar oṃ sogs nas/ dpa' bo mkha' 'gro bka' srung dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥzhes dang*/ dbyangs rol bcas spyan 'dren ni/ hūm̐ bhyoḥ gnas mchog 'og min stug po bkod// mkha' la spyod dang au ḍa yān// so sa gling sogs gar bzhugs nas// mkha' 'gro'i dbang mo 'khor bcas gshegs// dad dang dam tshig ldan pa yi// rnal 'byor sgrub po bdag cag gis// bstan dang 'gro ba'i don slad du// yum chen mkha' 'gro spyan 'dren no// ye shes mkha' 'gro kun gyi gtso// seng ge'i gdong can gshegs su gsol// rdo rje rigs kyi mkha' 'gro ma// rngam pa'i zhal ldan gshegs su gsol// sangs rgyas rin chen padma dang*// las kyi rigs kyi mkha' 'gro ma// sprul pa yang sprul 'khor dang bcas// gnas 'dir myur du gshegs su gsol// oṃ ḍā ki nī siṃ ha mu khī sa pa ri ra e hye hi/

zhes pas spyan drangs/ hūm̐/ ye shes las grub dag pa'i gzhal med khang*// gru gsum mthing nag pad nyi ro yi gdan// me rlung 'khrugs pa'i dkyil 'khor chen po 'dir// mkha' 'gro 'khor bcas brtan par bzhugs su gsol// mtshan sngags mthar ā sa na tiṣṭhantu/ zhes bzhugs su gsol/ sngags sngon 'gros arghaṃ āḥhūm̐ nas/ shabda āḥhūm̐ gi bar gyis mchod la/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs mdun bskyed la bstim/ dbang lha spyan drang*/ mchod de dbang bskur nas/ chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las gtso mo'i spyi bor mi bskyod pa'i ngo bo rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa dang*/ gzhan rnams kyi spyi bor rigs gzhan bzhi'i 'khor lo rin po che padma ral gri rnams kyis dbur brgyan par bsam/ de nas mchod pa rnams/ rgyal kun sbyin pa'i pha rol phyin stobs dang*// bdag cag lhag bsam smon lam bden stobs kyis// phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod sprin bskal pa'i bar// mchod yul kun gyi spyan lam rgyas gyur cig /oṃ āḥhūm̐ sarba pū dza me gha sa mu dra spha ra ṇaḥswā hā/ zhes pas rgya che rgyun mi chad par spel/ hūm̐/ rnam pa dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i sha khrag rus// ngo bo rdul bral ye shes rang snang sprin// mchod yon me tog bdug pa snang gsal dri// zhal zas rol mo mkha' 'gro dgyes phyir 'bul// oṃ ḍā ki nī siṃ ha mu khī sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badzra puṣpe nas shapda āḥhūm̐ zhes nyer spyod dang*/ hūm̐/ rang bzhin gdod nas rnam dag bdud rtsi'i mchog /sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga dang ye shes lnga// dbyer med ye shes bdud rtsir byin brlabs pa// mkha' 'gro 'khor bcas dgyes pa'i mchod pa 'bul// oṃ ḍā ki sogs gong ltar mjug ma hā pañtsa a mṛ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes sman phud dang*/ spro na phud mchod bya/ hūm̐/ phyi nang gsang ba'i kun rtog dgra tshogs rnams// skye med ye shes chen po'i klong yangs su// bsgral ba las byung rakta'i rgya mtsho che// mkha' 'gro 'khor bcas dgyes pa'i mchod par 'bul// sngags mthar ma hā rakta kha kha khā hi khā hi zhes rakta dang*/

hūm̐/ srid gsum rnam par dag pa'i gtor gzhong du// 'khor ba yongs sgrol dmar gyi gtor ma bshams// myang 'das ye shes lnga yi ngo bo nyid// sha rus bdud rtsi ye shes lngar byin rlabs// ro bcud brgya ldan sha khrag rgyan dang ldan// ma mo mkha' 'gro dgyes pa'i dam rdzas 'di// seng ge'i gdong can mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la 'bul// 'khor bcas mnyes nas dngos grub stsal du gsol// sngags mthar i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes gtor sngags lan gsum gyis phul la/ hūm̐/ zhe sdang rnam dag rnam shes gnas gyur pa// chos dbyings ye shes rang bzhin bcom ldan ma// thugs kyi rigs mchog mthing nag khro mo'i sku// seng ge'i gdong can ma la phyag 'tshal bstod// gti mug rnam dag gzugs phung gnas gyur pa// me long ye shes rang bzhin bcom ldan ma// sku yi rigs mchog rab dkar khro mo'i sku// seng ge'i gdong can ma= /ser sna'i rang bzhin tshor phung gnas gyur pa// mnyam nyid ye shes rang bzhin bcom ldan ma// yon tan rigs mchog gser 'dra khro mo'i sku// seng ge'i gdong can= /'dod chags rnam dag 'du shes gnas gyur pa// sor rtog ye shes rang bzhin bcom ldan ma// gsung gi rigs mchog rab dmar khro mo'i sku// seng ge'i gdong can= /phrag dog rnam dag 'du byed gnas gyur pa// bya grub ye shes rang bzhin bcom ldan ma// phrin las rigs mchog ljang sngon khro mo'i sku// seng ge'i gdong can ma la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes bstod/ tshogs rgyas pa zhu chen rin po ches mdzad pa ltar dang*/ bsdu na/ byin rlabs kye rdor ram mkha' spyod bzhin byas la/ dman pa'i yul sogs dang*/ zhal zas ro brgya sogs kyi mthar rtsa sngags la gtor sngags btags pas dbul/ mkha' 'gro spyi gtor sngags kyis kyang phul la rol/ lhag ma bsdus la gtang ngo*// de nas skong ba ni/ skong rdzas la dmigs te/ oṃ/ chos dbyings ngang las shar ba'i mchod sprin 'di// dngos bshams yid sprul lha yi byin rlabs dang*// bden pa'i mthu yis mkha' 'gro mnyes byed rdzas// mkha' dang sa gzhi khyab par 'byung gyur cig

/oṃ sarba bid pū ra sogs kyis byin gyis brlabs nas/ skong gtor oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥlan gsum gyis brlab/ gtor sngags gsum gyis phul la/ hūm̐/ skye med rnam dag chos sku'i ngang nyid las// skye ba'i cho 'phrul gzugs kyi skur bstan ma// seng ge'i gdong can 'khor dang bcas pa la// bdag gis mthun pa'i dam rdzas 'bul ba ni// gtsang ma'i mchod yon dri zhim zhabs bsil dang*// khrus kyi zhal bsil mdzes ldan me tog gsar// dri bzang bdug spos mun sel mar me'i phreng*// zhi bsil dri mchog zhal zas bdud rtsi'i tshogs// snyan 'jebs rol mo zhing kun khyab pa dang*// thod mkhar 'bar ba g.yang gzhi'i bla re bres// glo snying 'phyang 'phrul rgyu rlon lda ldi dpyangs// khrag zhag 'khyil ba'i gzhi la keng rus bkram// mi mgo'i tog dang zhing gi rgyal mtshan phyar// drag po'i gzhal yas mtshan nyid ldan pa'i nang*// sha khrag mchod yon dbang lnga'i me tog bstar// tshil chen bdug spos zhun chen mar me sbar// mkhris pa'i dri mchog sha rus zhal zas tshogs// mi rkang gling bu thod pa ltag skrod rnga// dgra bgegs 'gugs byed drag po'i ngag tshig dbyangs// gsang ba'i dam rdzas sngangs skrag skyed pa dang*// gzhan yang gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya'i phul// rgyal srid bdun dang nye ba'i rin chen bdun// mda' mdung ral gri mtshon cha ngar ldan sogs// gri gug thod khrag kha ṭwāṃ ga la sogs// byin gyis brlabs pa'i phyag mtshan sna tshogs 'bul// rin chen rus rgyan mi mgo skam rlon phreng*// dar dpyangs stag lpags la sogs sku yi chas// rnga dung sil snyan dbyings sogs gsung gi rdzas// rigs lnga'i phyag mtshan la sogs thugs mnyes byed// mkha' 'gro 'khor bcas dgyes pa bskyed phyir 'bul// ri rab gling bzhi gling phran rol mtshor bcas// lha mi'i longs spyod kun bzang mchod pa'i sprin// dngos bshams yid sprul mchod par 'os pa kun// mkha' 'gro seng ge'i gdong pa can la 'bul// gtso mo 'khor bcas thugs dam bskangs gyur nas// rnal 'byor bdag dang yon bdag 'khor bcas kyi// mi mthun rkyen dang bar chad thams cad zlog

/byad ka rbod gtong byad mkhan rang la bzlog /mi dang mi min gnod pa zhi bar mdzod// tshe dang bsod nams rgyas pa'i dngos grub stsol// bdag sogs srung zhing skyob pa'i phrin las mdzod// thar pa'i lam brnyes byang chub thob pa sogs// mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsal du gsol// dbang bzhi'i dam tshig zab gsal bskyed rdzogs bsgom// snying po'i sngags bzlas las bzhi'i phrin las kyis// sems can don byed yang dag lta ldan pas// mkha' 'gro 'khor bcas thugs dam bskangs gyur cig /hūm̐/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad skyed mdzad yum// chos dang longs spyod sprul pa'i skur ston kyang*// sku gsum dbyer med ngo bo nyid sku'i dngos// gtso mchog rdo rje seng gdong thugs dam bskang*// zhi rgyas dbang drag phrin las lhun grub phyir// rigs bzhi mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyi thugs= /legs nyes stangs 'dzin dam tshig rjes skyong ba// gnas gsum dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i thugs dam= /grub pa'i rtags dang mtshan ma ci yang ston// mthu ldan 'jig rten mkha' 'gro'i thugs= /bka' nyan las byed sprul pa yangs sprul gyi// ma mo mkha' 'gro 'bum gyi thugs dam bskang*// bskang ngo mkha' 'gro'i thugs dam gnyen po bskang*// bshags so bdag rgyud nyes ltung mtha' dag bshags// bzlog go mi mthun rkyen dang bar chad bzlog /stsol lo dngos grub ma lus deng 'dir stsol// bskul lo dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i las la bskul// mdzod cig bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod// mthol bshags ni/ hūm̐ bhyoḥ ye shes dbyings kyi yum chen mkha' 'gro ma// khro zhal rngam pa seng ge'i gdong can ma// khyed thugs dbyings las g.yo ba mi mnga' yang*// bdag sogs sems can don la dgongs su gsol// thog med dus nas tha ma da lta'i bar// ma rig 'khrul pa'i nyon mongs dbang gyur pas// so sor thar dang byang sems gsang sngags kyi// sdom pa gsum dang 'gal ba mthol lo bshags// khyad par lus ngag yid gsum mkha' 'gro yi// gsang ba gsum du ma shes mthol lo bshags// mdor na thugs 'gal nyes pa ci mchis pa// mthol lo bshags so tshangs pa'i dngos grub stsol// zhes so// bzlas pa ni/

rang nyid seng gdong mar gsal ba'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rnams kyi thugs kar phog thugs rgyud bskul/ de dag gi thugs rje byin rlabs nus mthu thams cad 'od zer mthing ga'i rnam par byon nas/ zor gtor lhar gsal ba la thim pas srid pa gsum gyi 'byung po thams cad dran pa tsam gyis 'joms par nus pa'i rang bzhin du gyur par bsams la/ rtsa sngags ci nus bzlas mthar/ hūm̐ bhyoḥ rgyal ba kun yum rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma// siṃ ha mu kha'i lha tshogs 'khor bcas rnams// dgyes pa bskyed pa'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes la// gang bcol phrin las 'di dag 'grub par mdzod// rgyal bstan dar zhing bstan 'dzin zhabs pad brtan// bdag cag yon mchod bar chad zhi ba dang*// sdom gsum gnang bkag dam tshig rnam par dag /mchog thun dngos grub bde blag thob par mdzod// ces phrin las bcol/ bsgral las ni/ liṅga bshams par/ rdo rje'i rtses nang mchod nas gtor te bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las kham̐ nag po yongs su gyur pa las gnam lcags las grub pa'i gshin rje'i khang sgrom gru gsum pa/ kha dog cing gting zab pa/ steng nas dug mtshon ser char 'bebs pa/ 'og nas khrag nad rlangs pa 'phyur ba/ gsod bcod nam mkha'i 'brug ltar sgrogs pa/ gshin rje nag po'i kha gdangs pa lta bu zin nas thar sa med pa'i ro dong nag po/ de'i nang du nṛ yongs su gyur pa las gnod byed dgra bgegs thams cad kyi ngo bo/ liṅga gcer bu lus rid cing nyam thag pa/ gdong mchi ma'i rgyun gyis g.yogs pa/ bu ga dgu nas rnag khrag 'dzag cing*/ mdze dang phol mig du mas btab pa/ rkang lag lcags sgrog tu bcug pa/ mgon skyabs bral bas skrag cing 'dar ba'i rnam pa can du gyur/ ces brjod/ bdag gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer tsha zhing rtsub pa dpag tu med pa 'phros/ mdun bskyed kyi mkha' 'gro ma 'khor dang bcas pa'i thugs kar phog pas/

thugs rgyud rang dbang med par bskul/ de dag las rang 'dra'i pho nya las mkhan khro 'khrug rngam pa lag na lcags kyu zhags pa lcags sgrog dril bu sogs mtshon cha thogs pa stong gsum khyab par 'phros/ gnod byed dgra bgegs byad ma gang du gnas pa nas rang dbang med par bkug ste gzugs brnyan la gnyis su med par thim par bsams la/ hūm̐ mdzad kyi phyag rgya dang bcas te/ dzaḥrje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i sogs nas/ mkha' 'gro ma seng ge'i gdong pa can/ mkha' 'gro ma bye ba 'bum sde'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams kyi bden pa dang*/ bden pa chen po'i byin gyis brlabs kyis rgyal ba'i bstan pa bshig pa/ dkon mchog gi dbu 'phang smad dang*/ sems can yongs la 'tshe ba/ khyad par du yang bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa rnams lan pa med par gnod cing gdug sems 'chang ba'i gzugs can gyi dgra/ gzugs med kyi bgegs/ gzhan yang bsam sbyor ngan pa'i byad ka rbod gtong*/ 'khrul 'khor gtad khram ltas ngan rigs gyur thams cad skad cig nyid la 'di nyid du khug cig phob cig ces dang*/ a ka sa ma sogs kyi mthar sarba sha trūn ā karṣa ya dzaḥzhes dang*/ oṃ badzra aṃ ku sha dzaḥ.oṃ badzra pā sha hūm̐/ oṃ badzra ghaṇḍe hoḥ zhes phyag rgya dang bcas te lan gsum gyis dgug gzhug bcing dbang bya/ slar yang*/ rje btsun rtsa ba dang sogs nas/ ltas ngan rigs gyur thams cad srung skyobs byed pa'i lha dang phyes shig de bzhin du sbyar te/ stong grogs byed pa'i lha/ pho lha/ mo lha/ zhang lha/ srog lha/ yul lha/ srung 'khor gyi lha/ yi dam gyi lha/ nus mthu skyed pa'i lha dang phyes shig rtsa sngags la sarba sha trūn sarba de bā udgha ṭa ya phaṭa/ ces brjod pas mgon skyabs kyi lha dang dbye/ de nas phrin las la bskul ba ni/ gtor chung zhig kyang bran te/ gser skyems gtor la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rtsa brgyud bla ma yi dam dkon mchog gsum// snang zhing srid pa'i lha srin sde brgyad dang*// yul phyogs 'dir gnas gzhi bdag gnyen po rnams// gser skyems mchod pa dam pa 'di bzhes la// mngon spyod las la phrag dog ma mdzad par// bstan dgra spangs nas bdag gi dpung gnyen mdzod// bhyoḥchos dbyings rnam dag nam mkha'i klong yangs nas// rab 'jigs dur khrod chen pos yongs su bskor// chos 'byung gru gsum mthing nag 'bar ba'i dbus// ye shes me dpung 'bar ba'i klong dkyil nas// mkha' 'gro bye ba'i gtso mo sku bzhengs shig

/rigs bzhi'i mkha' 'gro shugs 'gro sku bzhengs shig /gnas gsum ma mo mkha' 'gro sku bzhengs shig /sprul pa yang sprul tshogs rnams sku bzhengs shig /pho nya las mkhan tshogs rnams sku bzhengs shig /sha khrag brgyan pa'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la// drag po'i phrin las bskul la da tshur gson// rgyal bstan bshig dang dkon mchog dbu 'phang mod// bla ma'i sku dgra sems can yongs la 'tshe// rnal 'byor yon mchod byang chub sgrub pa la// bar du gcod pa'i dgra bgegs byad ma'i tshogs// da lta nyid du bsgral ba'i phrin las mdzod// mdor na sdang zhing gdug sems ldan pa 'di// lo dang zla ba'i yun tshad ma bzhag par// zhag dang za ma'i dus mtshams da lta nyid// bsad cing bsgral nas rnam shes dbyings su sgrol// dam nyams dgra bgegs las ngan sdig can 'di'i// gnam gyi 'ju thag dkar po steng nas chod// sa yi rten phur nag po 'og nas phyungs// mgon skyob byed pa'i lha srung kun dang phrol// lus la dug nad mtshon cha'i char pa phob// ngag nas smre sngags lhang lhang 'don du chug /yid kyis ting 'dzin sgom pa rmugs su chug /rnam shes skye med mkha' 'gro'i thugs dang sres// sha khrag rus pa lhag med tshogs su rol// rigs brgyud nye 'brel 'khor g.yog rtsad nas phyungs// yul gzhis zas nor dus mtha'i rlung la bskur// thal ba'i rdul phran tsam yang med par mdzod// phyin chad dgra bgegs byad ma'i tshogs rnams kyis// bdag la glags lta'i skabs rnyed med par mdzod// bsam ngan gdug rtsub sdig pa'i rgyun bcad de// thams cad bdag gi dbang du 'gyur bar mdzod// ces bskul zhing*/ phur pa thogs la/ hūm̐/ nga ni dus gsum bde gshegs thams cad kyi// sprul pa'i las byed seng ge'i gdong can ma// mkha' 'gro'i gtso mo dam nyams byad ma'i gshed// lag na gdug can gsod pa'i phur pa thogs// sku stod khro chen 'bar ba rngams shing brjid// sku smad gnam lcags phur bu zur gsum dbal// reg pas gcod pa'i ye shes mtshon rnon 'di// dgra bgegs snying gi dkyil du btab tsam gyis// las ngan rgyun bcad lus ngan rdul du rlog

/rnam shes rdor sems rnam pas mkha' la spar// dgra bgegs byad ma'i lus ngag yid gsum gyi// nus mthu bkrag mdangs bsod nams lhag ma bcas// 'bru gsum sa bon gzugs gyur bdag la thim// bdag gi sgo gsum mthu stobs gzi brjid rgyas// oṃ āḥhūm̐ nṛ dzaḥzhes dang*/ phur bu'i dbu gtsug gis rang gi gnas gsum du gtugs te/ slar yang*/ a ka sa ma sogs dang*/ badzra kī li kī la ya dgra bo byad ma'i srog snying la mā ra ya dzaḥdzaḥrbad rbad e sa bhyoḥrbad/ ces mang du bzla zhing*/ dgra bgegs kyi snying gar btab cing thun brabs pas tshe'i rgyun bcad/ rnam shes rten dang bcas pa rdul du brlag nam mkhar gnas pa'i rdo rje sems dpa' dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i 'khor gyis bskor te mchod pa'i tshogs dang bcas mi bskyod pa'i zhing du skad cig la gshegs par bsams nas phaṭa drag tu brjod/ mthar 'khor gsum mi dmigs pa spros bral gyi ngang du mnyam par bzhag liṅga ral gris gtubs la zhal bstab bya ba ni/ hūm̐/ mi bzad sdig pa'i las la ches rngams pa'i// dug gsum gong bur gyur pa'i bdud dgra rnams// skye med dbyings su sbyor sgrol bgyis pa yi// sha rus ri bo khrag zhag rgya mtshor gyur// mkha' 'gro bye ba'i gtso mo'i zhal du bstab// drag mo seng ge'i gdong can zhal= /rigs bzhi mkha' 'gro shugs 'gro'i zhal= /gnas gsum ma mo mkha' 'gro'i zhal= /sprul pa yang sprul tshogs kyi zhal du bstab// zhal du bstabs pa kha kha khā hi hoḥ /dgyes par rol nas dngos grub stsol cig gu// zlog pa ni/ ling ro gtor ma bcas sha khrag gis brgyan pa bran la/ 'bru gsum lan gsum gyis brlab/ zlog dmigs man ngag ltar dang*/ bdag mdun gyi lha tshogs thams cad dam nyams dgra bgegs la shin tu khros pa'i shangs nas hūm̐ zhes brjod pa'i rlung dang mnyam du sku dang ral pa las rang 'dra'i sprul pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa spros/

de rnams kyis bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa'i bar chad mi mthun pa'i phyogs byad ka rbod gtong gtso bor gyur pa thams cad rdul du bshig ro ma rjes med du gtor/ des ma zhi ba'i pha rol byad gtad kyi nus mthu thams cad kho rang gi gshed du bab cing tshar gcod pa'i las mdzad de zhal nas bhyoḥzlog gi nga ro 'jig rten g.yo ba tsam du yod par bsams la 'di skad do/ ham̐'u/ rgyal ba kun gyi mthu stobs nus pa'i tshogs// gcig bsdus gdug pa tshar gcod seng ge'i gdong*// khro mo'i sku yi nyams dang cha byad rdzogs// sprul pas stong gsum bstan dgra'i dpung tshogs bcom// rgyal rnams sku gsung thugs yon phrin las kyi// rang bzhin rigs bzhi seng ge'i gdong can ma// ma mo mkha' 'gro sprul pa yang sprul bcas// rdzu 'phrul mthu ldan mkha' 'gro bye ba 'bum// las la 'gyed pa'i mkha' 'gro seng gdong can// 'khor bcas sha khrag gtor ma 'di bzhes la// de ring zlog sgyur phrin las 'grub par mdzod// ces ling ro gtong chung zor du bstabs shing bskul nas/ zlog pa dngos ni/ bhyoḥ dpa' mo rab 'jigs seng ge'i gdong can ma// rigs bzhi mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang shugs 'gror bcas// gnas gsum ma mo mkha' 'gro thams cad dang*// sprul pa yang sprul bcas pa tshur dgongs la// deng 'dir bstan pa'i bshad sgrub spel ba dang*// sems can phan 'dogs bde skyid sgrub pa dang*// rnal 'byor bdag cag yon mchod 'khor bcas rnams// chos dang srid pa'i bde 'byor sgrub pa la// sdang sems gdug sems dug chus cher myos pa'i// gnod byed bon chos mu stegs gang yin gyis// mnan gzir byad gtad ngan pa gang brtsams pa// byad mkhan de de'i gshed du bzlog cing bsgyur// bdud dang gshin rje srin po ma mo btsan// rgyal 'gong 'byung po dam sri the'u rang sogs// snang srid lha srin dregs byed rbad bskul gyi// nyer 'tshe thams cad bzlog cing bsgyur du gsol// srid par kun rtog rdzing bu rnyog byed cing*// bar chad 'jug pa'i pho nya dang po'i 'phrin// ltas ngan ye 'brog rmi lam ngan pa'i rigs// 'bras bu 'byin nus med par bzlog cing bsgyur// gnam lo zla ba zhag dus spar sme yi// 'byung khams mi mthun gcod 'dral las byung ba'i// keg 'phrang sri langs na shi dur zhugs kyi// chag che nyam nga bzlog cing bsgyur du gsol// gdon bgegs 'byung tshogs 'khrugs pa'i kha yi rlangs// rlung mkhris bad kan ldan 'dus las gyur pa'i// mi nad phyugs nad yams nad 'go ba'i rigs// mi 'byung byung ba bzlog cing bsgyur du gsol// sngon las ngan dang glo bur rkyen byung gi// dus min 'chi bar 'gyur ba ci snyed dang*// mi nor gang stongs rigs chad rgud pa sogs// skal ngan thams cad bzlog cing bsgyur du gsol// gzhan gyi dpal 'byor 'phrog la ches rngams pa'i// dgra jag chom rkun dmag 'khrugs 'jigs pa dang*// kha smras rtsod pa rgyal po'i 'jigs pa sogs// dngangs skrag 'jigs pa thams cad bzlog cing bsgyur// bla ma'i sku dgra bstan pa'i spyi dgra dang*// rnal 'byor bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas la// snga dgra byas dang da dgra snying la bcang*// phyi dgra khyi ltar zug pa'i sdang dgra rnams// sa 'og sa steng sa bla gar bros kyang*// rings par khug la bzung dang bcing brdeg btubs// bsad bcad bsgral nas rnam shes chos dbyings stims// ji ltar bcol pa'i phrin las bsgrub mdzod cig

/ces brjod cing rtsa sngags kyi mjug tu/ lha srin sde brgyad mi dang mi ma yin pa'i byad ka rbod gtong thams cad byad ma gnod byed kyi steng du e sa bhyoḥbhyoḥzlog zlog ces bzla/ zlog pa bsdus pa ni/ bhyoḥ dpa' mo rab 'jigs seṅge'i gdong can ma// cho 'phrul bsam yas mkha' 'gro 'khor bcas kyis// mthu dang nus pa rdzu 'phrul cher bskyed la// bzlog par bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod// mi dang mi min su dang gang gi'ang rung*// ngan sngags zor kha mnan gtad 'khrul 'khor sogs// ngan par brtsams pa'i bsam sbyor mtha' dag ni// byad mkhan de nyid rang la bzlog par mdzod// nam mkha' gang ba lha yi cho 'phrul dang*// bar snang khyab pa gnyan gyi gdug rtsub dang*// sa gzhi gang ba klu yi gnod pa rnams// thams cad bzlog cing bsgyur ba'i phrin las mdzod// sngon gyi las la dbang bas sna drangs pa'i// lha srin sde brgyad gdug pa'i gnod pa yi// nad dang gdon dang bar chad ci mchis pa// mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis bzlog cing bsgyur bar mdzod// byang chub sgrub pa'i gegs su gyur pa yi// 'gal rkyen tshogs dang mi mthun thog tu bab// bsam la bar du gcod pa thams cad kyang*// yid kyi nus pas myur du bzlog tu gsol// bdag la sems pa'i gang zag thams cad dang*// sbyin pa'i bdag po phan sems ldan pa la// gnod cing 'tshe ba'i log 'dren bgegs kyi tshogs// ma lus bzlog cing bsgral nas med par mdzod// mdor na bsam ngan sbyor rtsub gang brtsams pa// de dag de ring nyid la bzlog pa dang*// nam mkhar sprin ltar dengs par mdzad nas kyang*// 'dod pa'i don kun 'grub par mdzad du gsol// zhes dang*/ rtsa sngags zlog sngags sham can bzla'o// de yan chad zhag grangs ci rigs par bya'o// nyi ma snga ma rnams su de nas thun gtor skyong ba sogs la 'jug go /zor skul ni/ nyin rjes mar gtor chen 'gro phyogs su zhal bsgyur la/

dkyil 'khor dang gtor ma tha mi dad par lhar bskyed pa yin pas gtor ma mar me gcig las gnyis chad du shes pa'i ngang nas/ gzhi bdag gtor ma btang zhing stong grogs bcol/ gser skyems 'thor zhing*/ hūm̐/ rtsa brgyud bla ma yi dam lha// mkha' 'gro lha srin sde brgyad dang*// yul lha sa bdag bcas pa rnams// gser skyems mchod pa 'di bzhes la// bstan dgra rdul du brlag pa'i phyir// de ring mngon spyod brtsams pa la// ko long phrag dog ma mdzad par// bdag gi rgyab rten dpung grogs mdzod// yid la brnags pa'i dgra bo 'dis// sangs rgyas bstan pa'i spyi dgra byas// dkon mchog gsum la skur pa btab// dpal ldan bla ma'i sku dgra byas// rnal 'byor bdag gi sgos dgra byed// de bas bsgral ba'i zhing gyur 'di// las ngan rgyun chags 'gog phyir du// myur du bsgral la gnang ba stsol// de nas bdud 'dul mkha' 'gro 'khor tshogs sprul par bcas pa 'jig rten dregs pa'i tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang bcas dgra phyogs su rngams bzhin chas par bsams la/ hūm̐/ da ni dus gsum bde gshegs kyi// sprul pa'i mkha' 'gro seng ge'i gdong*// ye shes 'jig rten mkha' 'gro'i tshogs// dgra bgegs byad ma'i srog gi gshed// srid gsum gnas na nga dbang che// las la mi 'khol 'ga' yang med// nga yi gtor zor gnyan po 'di// steng gi lha la mi 'phang ngo*// 'og gi klu la mi 'phen no// bar gyi gnyan la mi 'phang ngo*// dgra bgegs byad ma bsgral ba'i phyir// drag po zor gyi las byed do// bhyoḥ shar phyogs rgyal po yul 'khor srung*// dri za'i dmag tshogs grangs med bcas// gser skyems mchod pa 'di bzhes la// gtor zor gnyan po'i lam yangs phyes// dmag dpung bskyed la ru mtshon phyor// zor sna dgra bo'i yul du drongs// bhyoḥ lho phyogs rgyal chen 'phags skyes po// gshin rje'i dmag tshogs grangs med bcas// gser skyems sogs gong ltar 'gres/

bhyoḥ nub phyogs rgyal po spyan mi bzang*// klu gdon dmag tshogs grangs med bcas// gser skyems sogs/ bhyoḥbyang phyogs rgyal chen rnam thos sras// gnod sbyin dmag tshogs grangs med bcas// gser skyems sogs/ bhyoḥ steng 'og phyogs mtshams gnas pa yi// lha klu 'byung po 'khor bcas rnams// gser skyems mchod pa 'di bzhes la// gtor zor gnyan po'i lam yangs phyes// dmag dpung bskyed la ru mtshon phyor// zor sna dgra bo'i yul du drongs// zhes so// de nas gtor zor sogs gang du 'phen pa'i sa der spyan drangs la bran/ las gtad ni/ thog mar phud mchod 'bru gsum gyis brlabs la/ phyogs bcu dus gsum bde gshegs thams cad kyi// mkhyen brtse nus pa yon tan kun gyi dngos// dbang rgyun byin rlabs gdams stsol bka' drin che// 'khor lo'i mgon po'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐// rdo rje 'chang dbang dpa' mo seng ge'i gdong*// brgyud pa'i bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i tshogs// rang lus lhar gsal chos srung nor lha dang*// gnas bdag gzhi bdag rigs drug sems can rnams// lha ru gsal ba'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐// mchod yul dgyes nas las kyi dngos grub stsol// sbyin yul tshim nas gnod sems spong gyur cig /ces dang*/ rang gis kyang myangs la a ka sa ma sogs brjod do// de nas 'di skad gyer te/ hūm̐/ rab 'jigs dur khrod 'bar ba'i klong*// dgra bgegs sgrol ba'i dkyil 'khor nas// ye shes 'jig rten mkha' 'gro'i tshogs// seng gdong drag mo zor la bzhengs// rigs bzhi'i drag mo zor la= /ye shes mkha' 'gro= /'jig rten mkha' 'gro= /mkha' 'gro bye 'bum= /sprul pa yang sprul= /bka' srung dam can= /gtsang ris dpal mgon= /lha srin sde brgyad= /yul lha gzhi bdag zor la bzhengs// bzhengs shig zor gyi mthu dpung skyed// kun kyang zor thogs las la sgrims// mthu stobs dus mtha'i rlung ltar skyed// dpung tshogs nyi zer rdul ltar spros// gzi brjid bskal pa'i me ltar skyed// mtshon char brag ri bsnyil ltar phob// 'jigs rungs nga ro 'brug ltar sgrogs// bstan dgra dam nyams yul du rgyugs// bcol pa'i phrin las grub par mdzod// zor chung thogs la/

hūm̐/ bstan dgra byad ma bsgral ba'i phyir// drag po'i gtor zor 'bar ba 'phen// hūm̐ phaṭa dzaḥbhyo mā ra ya'i// 'ur sgras stong gsum 'jig rten 'dar// thun zor rdo rje'i ser chen 'bebs// mtshe zor ral gri'i nags ltar 'khrugs// nyungs zor drag po'i char ltar phab// rdo zor gnam lcags sgyogs ltar 'phen// mda' zor rdugs med thog ltar rgyu// khrag zor zangs zhun bu yug 'tshubs// rtsangs zor spu gri'i so ltar gzings// gtor zor dug nad mtshon cha'i char// gang la bab pa brlag byed 'di// bstan dgra dam nyams steng du 'phen// mi ro rdza ltar nyil du chug /mi khrag mtsho ltar 'khyil du chug /mā ra ya yi las mdzod cig /ces drag rol gyi khongs su gtor ma/ thun/ mtshe/ nyungs/ rdo/ mda'/ khrag zor rnams 'phang*/ de nas zor chen thogs la/ bhyoḥ mthu ldan mkha' 'gro srung ma'i tshogs// pho nya las mkhan bcas pa rnams// bskul lo drag po'i las la bskul// rbad do gnod byed thog tu rbad// yid la brnag pa'i dgra bo 'di'i// yul gzhis sgo nor mtha' nas sdus// dgra bo'i pho rgyud rtsad nas chod// dgra bo'i mo rgyud mngal nas skoms// dgra bo'i rigs rgyud drungs nas phyung*// ltag pa'i phyogs nas bdud sgo phyes// gdong pa'i phyogs nas 'od mdangs 'phrogs// kha nas dbugs kyi rgyu ba chod// khong nas srog rtsa dmar po gtubs// snying khrag dmar po skom du 'thungs// don snying dmar po zhal du bzhes// nang khrol sha khrag rus pa'i tshogs// rol gcig lhag med bzhes nas kyang*// rnam shes skye med chos dbyings sbyor// bcol pa'i phrin las grub par mdzod// ces dang*/ rtsa sngags mthar tri ra dza sa ma ya byad ma'i srog la gtubs/ zhes sam/ dgra bo byad ma'i srog snying la mā ra ya dzaḥdzaḥrbad rbad/ dgra bo byad ma'i tshe dang bsod nams la mā ra ya dzaḥdzaḥrbad rbad ces btags pa'i bsad sngags bzla zhing*/

gtor zor nad dug mtshon cha'i phung por gyur pa dgra bo mngon sum du dmigs pa'i steng du brgyabs pas mi nor yul mkhar dang bcas pa rdul du brlag par bsams la bsgral bya sgrol byed sgrol ba po'i 'khor gsum rang bzhin gyis ma grub pa'i don la mnyam par bzhag ste nang du log go /thun gtor skyong ba ni/ bhyoḥ dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma// rab 'jigs seng ge'i gdong can ma// sha za ma mo'i tshogs dang bcas// 'dir gshegs brgyan pa'i gtor ma bzhes// sha dang khrag gi dam rdzas dang*// bdud rtsi sman gyi mchod pa dang*// thun dang zor du bcas pa yi// drag po'i mchod gtor 'di dag bzhes// sngar bcol grub pa'i gtang rag 'bul// da bcol las kyi skul mar 'bul// dam tshig srung ba'i cho gar 'bul// mkha' 'gro dgyes pa'i mchod par 'bul// bzhes nas bstan pa rgyas pa dang*// dgra bgegs 'dul ba'i phrin las mdzod// bdag gi 'dod pa'i don rnams kun// yid bzhin du ni 'grub par mdzod// mchod do mkha' 'gro 'khor bcas mchod// bzhes shig rdzas dang gtor mchod bzhes// bskul lo phrin las rnam bzhi bskul// mdzod cig dus las ma g.yel mdzod// ces dang*/ gong ltar bsad sngags bzlas la gtor ma dgra phyogs su gtong ngo*// rjes ni/ mchod pa byin rlabs dang*/ mtshan sngags re re bzhin sngon du 'gro bas mchod/ bstod pa'ang gong bzhin dang*/ gur zhal gyi skong ba dang 'brel na/ kolla man chod mtha' bsdu/ yig brgyas lhag chad kha bskang*/ ma 'byor pa dang sogs kyis nongs pa bshags/ nyin snga ma rnams la brtan bzhugs/ nyin rjes mar/ oṃ khyed kyis sogs kyis gshegs gsol dang*/ bstim/ gnas gsum bsrung*/ dge bsngo bkra shis kyis mtha' brgyan par bya'o// rgyal ba kun gyi mthu stobs nus pa'i gter// mkha' 'gro seng ge'i gdong can ma'i// gtor zlog khrigs su bsdebs pa'i dges// bstan dgra phye mar 'thag gyur cig

/ces gser chos lugs kyi mkha' 'gro ma seng ge'i gdong pa can gyi gtor zlog dgra bgegs dpung 'joms zhes bya ba 'di'ang rje bla ma'i bzhed skong du zhu chen ma hā paṇḍi ta'i gsung las rgyas bsdus 'tshams par blo gter dbang pos bsdebs pa'i dge bas nag phyogs kla klo'i 'tshubs 'gyur la sogs pa bskal pa ngan pa'i phyogs thams cad zhi nas bstan 'dzin yun du gsal zhing*/ 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad phan bder spyod pa'i rgyur gyur cig/ ༈ /mngon spyod las sbyor dgos pa'i zor rdzas kyi nus pa skyed pa'i byin rlabs ni/ rang dang mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i bla ma yi dam rnams kyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas/ mdun bskyed kyi drag mo seng gdong*/ ma mo mkha' 'gro/ sprul pa yang sprul/ chos skyong 'jig rten skyong ba thams cad kyi thugs rgyud bskul bas/ de rnams kyi thugs ka nas mthu stobs nus pa thams cad 'od zer dmar nag tsha zhing rtsub pa'i tshogs du ma dag sprul pa'i las mkhan khro mo dpag tu med pa 'phros/ zor rdzas rnams la gnyis su med par thim pas/ gang la dmigs pa skad cig nyid la thogs pa med par 'joms pa'i nus stobs dang ldan par gyur par bsams la/ 'jigs pa'i nga ro dang bcas pas/ hūm̐/ dpal ldan rtsa brgyud bla ma'i tshogs rnams kyis// zor rdzas 'di rnams bstan dgra byad ma'i rigs// gang la bsnun 'phral tshar gcod las byed pa'i// dug nad thog gi nus pa da skyed cig /de bzhin du tshig rkang phyi ma gsum 'gres te// yi dam zhi khro rab 'byams lha tshogs kyis// zor rjes sogs/ bdud 'dul drag mo seng gdong rigs lnga yis/ = = = /'khor gyi mkha' 'gro 'bum sde'i tshogs rnams kyis/ = = = /las byed sprul pa'i khro bo khro mo'i tshogs/ = = = /'jig rten mthu chen dregs pa'i sde tshogs kyis/ = = = /bstan pa'i spyi dgra bla ma'i sku dgra dang*// rnal 'byor bdag cag yon mchod 'khor bcas la// bsam sbyor rtsub mor rtsom pa'i dgra bgegs rnams// tshar gcod zor gyi nus pa da skyed cig

/ces rtsa sngags mthar gnod byed dgra bgegs byad ma'i srog rtsa la e sa bhyo bhyo rbad ces btags pa ci nus bzlas mthar/ thal mo sbyar te/ bla ma yi dam chos skyong 'jig rten skyong*// sku gsung thugs dang yon tan phrin las kyi// mthu rtsal dpag yas grub pa'i bden pa des// zor rdzas nus mthu gzi brjid 'bar gyur cig /ces byin gyis brlab bo// dza yandu// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o// //
